title: NAFEMS FV32: cantilevered tapered membrane
model: the membrane as half a 250 mm plate (its in-plane frequencies do not depend on the thickness) on a mid-plane roller, clamped along x = 0; stainless_steel, E 200 GPa, nu 0.3, 7900 kg/m^3; 250 mm elements

f1.source: NAFEMS, The Standard NAFEMS Benchmarks, TNSB Rev. 3 (1990), test FV32, mode 1
f1.scale_reason: the benchmark's steel is 8000 kg/m^3 at E 200 GPa, nu 0.3; the library's stainless_steel is 7900 kg/m^3 at the same E and nu, and a frequency goes as sqrt(E/rho): the target is the published value times sqrt(8000/7900)
f1.reason: 250 mm quadratic tets put about eight elements across mode 1's half-wave at the root, which a tet10 resolves to a few tenths of a percent; a 250 mm thick solid is plane stress to (t/L)^2 nu^2, under 0.01 %; the targets are quoted to five figures
